body_edits.diff: I feel its a bad design to have access control requirements in v1. I feel they belong in v12 so v12 is complete. I suggest we do this for all documentation requirements **_when we can_** so each section is as complete as possible in and of itself. I do not like the idea of having to hop to several different sections to get requirements on one category.
